---
title: Model and Parser
---

## Overview

SearchAgent separates model transport from model format:

1. The parser converts SearchAgent messages into the model's expected format.
2. The LLM client sends that payload to a provider or inference server.
3. The parser converts the response back into an assistant message and tool calls.

This separation lets one endpoint serve models with different chat templates, and lets one parser work with any compatible provider.

## Choosing Parser

A parser owns message formatting and tool-call decoding. It does not make network
requests. Built-in parser types are:

| Type | Use case |
| --- | --- |
| `upstream` | Provider-native tool calls, such as OpenAI-compatible APIs |
| `tongyi_deep_research` | Tongyi DeepResearch text-format tool calls using `<tool_call>` tags |
| `websailor` | WebSailor prompt assembly and text-format tool calls |

Configure the parser with `agent.parser.type`:

```{.yaml filename="config.yaml"}
agent:
  parser:
    type: tongyi_deep_research
```

For most API-hosted models and locally deployed models with a `chat_template`, simply choose `type: upstream` without and extra configurations

::: {.callout-tip}
When deploying models with a tool call competable chat template with inference engines like `Sglang` or `vLLM`, remember to specify **tool parsers** so the inference engine can properly handles tool-call string and pass to searcherkit's upstream parser.
:::

## Connecting to LLM client

An LLM client owns API communication, request concurrency, usage data, and endpoint selection. It receives already formatted messages and returns the provider response. Built-in client types include `openai` and `anthropic`. 

An example client configuration:

```{.yaml filename="config.yaml"}
agent:
  llm_client:
    type: openai
    model: Qwen3-8B
    default_kwargs:
      temperature: 0.6
      top_p: 0.95
      extra_kwargs:
        enable_thinking: False
    api_key: EMPTY
    base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1
    concurrency_limit: 128
```

`default_kwargs` are included in every completion request for generation kwargs. Configure the `concurrency_limit` to limit the request rate for large scale execution.

::: {.callout-tip}
Check the manual of the model you wish to call for specify `kwargs` instructions.
:::

To add and use your own model provider, see
[Custom LLM client](../04-advanced-usage/01-custom-modules.qmd)

## Retry policy

LLM API endpoints are prone to network exceptions like `TimeoutError` or credential errors like `RateLimitError`. And LLMs sometimes produces invalid tool call strings, causing `ParsingError`. These errors are recoverable when another generation may produce valid output.

Configure them explicitly:

```{.yaml filename="config.yaml"}
agent:
  llm_retry_config:
    max_tries: 5
    max_time: 3600
    exceptions:
      - pkg://searchagent.llm.parsers:ParsingError
```

Only list errors that are safe to retry. Authentication errors, invalid model names, and other permanent configuration failures should surface immediately. Listed error would still surface if trial limit `max_tries` or trial time `max_time` is exhausted.
